summary: Fleet slice 5 (G2+G3): bind workspace ownership into the durable fact stream (parent_session_id on run_started/run_settled; recover() surfaces a mechanical facts_summary readable after restart) and expose a read-only subagent_topology tool merging the topology journal with lease disk truth per child or parent.

components.owning_subsystem: fleet lease lifecycle fact stream and recovery read surface (runner emission + coordinator recover summary + factory tool registration)
components.disposition: ADMIT as one narrow ownership-binding tranche. The program adds only mechanical provenance: parent_session_id on both lifecycle facts (source: parent_of's active+durable mechanical path), a facts count/ownership summary in recover() (no semantic judgment), and registration of the read-only merged-view tool. Settled facts are emitted before finish_run because store fencing accepts facts only from active leases; exactly-once remains _fleet_leases.pop + store SettlementError. No new store, no liveness policy, no takeover authority.
evidence: RED-first: settlement-fact test exposed a real gap — store.settle never appended run_settled to the facts stream at all; the fix emits the fact from the runner (run_started/run_settled symmetric) instead of changing slice1's store contract (gate test stays authoritative and green).
Restart probe: a fresh ProjectCoordinator on the same fleet_dir reads last_parent_session_id=parent-run-1 and run_started/run_settled counts from disk facts alone.
Adjacent fleet + topology + factory suites 84/84 PASS; ruff clean; pyright 0/0/0.
components.verification_level: RED-first focused TDD, adjacent fleet+topology+factory pytest, ruff, pyright, full not-real_llm pytest on the committed candidate
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: All new surfaces are read-only facts; the model decides takeover/reclaim actions via existing verbs with recover()/subagent_lease/subagent_topology disk truth. Exit: unset fleet opt-in keeps everything off; the tool then honestly reports lease unavailable while the topology view still works.
components.rollback_route: Revert the single commit. Facts JSONL entries gain an additive field (readers tolerate absence); state.json schema unchanged; no migration needed.

components.owning_subsystem: read-only merged topology+lease view tool (model agency surface)
components.disposition: ADMIT as a read-only observation tool: composes existing runner methods (parent_of/topology_snapshot/active_children/pending_obligations/lease_facts) into one text view; performs no writes, no takeover, no semantic judgment; degrades honestly per block (lease unavailable when fleet not wired).
evidence: Tool tests: child view merges parent binding + settled lease facts; parent view lists children/obligations; no-argument call fails closed; un-wired runner keeps topology with lease unavailable.
Factory registers the tool even with fleet off (degradation is per-block, not registration-gated).
components.verification_level: Focused tool tests + factory registration test
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Pure read; removing it removes no authority, only visibility.

components.owning_subsystem: deterministic regression for fact ownership binding, restart recovery, and merged view degradation
components.disposition: ADMIT as tests only (7 cases incl. factory registration with fleet off).
evidence: Two RED pre-implementation failures on the ownership tests; all 7 green after.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Tests expose mechanical facts and can be revised independently.

components.disposition: ADMIT as exact changed-path coverage and submitter declarations; A.5 stays mechanical.
evidence: Manifest partitions the exact changed-path set and declares the single control component.
components.verification_level: Local exact A.5 self-gate before publication
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Human/model review remains authority for classification truth.

g1.necessity: After slices 1-4, a restarted coordinator could see a workspace's lease and settlement but not which parent session owned it — ownership lived only in the separate session-store topology journal, so fleet disk truth alone could not answer takeover questions, and no tool merged both stores.

g2.authority_owner: existing FleetStore facts JSONL (per-workspace append-only stream) and existing session-store topology journal; the merged view composes two existing read-only authorities at read time
g2.non_duplication: No new store or second ownership record: parent_session_id is provenance attached to facts the runner already emits; recover()'s facts_summary is a mechanical aggregation of the same stream; the tool only reads.

model_evidence: recover() facts_summary (counts + last_parent_session_id) readable by a restarted coordinator
subagent_topology merged text view per child/parent incl. lease state and expires/expired
g3.recovery_or_reason: Exit is configuration-level (fleet opt-in off) or single-commit revert; append-only facts with an additive field are inert to older readers and no schema migration exists.

g4.rollback: Revert the single commit; no data migration (facts additive field, state.json schema unchanged).
verification: RED-first ownership tests failed pre-implementation (settlement fact absent entirely), 7/7 PASS after
